column1: Keith grabs the mike... "Dispatch.. 53Mary2 requesting backup at our 10-20..."
column2: 基斯拿起麥克風……「派遣中心……53Mary2 請求支援前往我們的 10-20……」

column1: Dispatch answers... "10-4, 53Mary2. Be advised...a support team has been dispatched to your 10-20."
column2: 派遣中心回答……「10-4，53Mary2。請注意……支援小組已派往你們的 10-20。」

column1: 53Mary2, you hear the radio crackle. I have traffic for you from 53Mary1."
column2: 「53Mary2，」你聽見無線電沙沙作響。「這裡有 53Mary1 給你的通報。」

column1: Where are you, Bonds!? You cringe at Captain Fletcher Hall's angry tone of voice.
column2: 「你在哪裡，邦茲！？」弗萊徹．霍爾警監憤怒的語氣讓你不寒而慄。

column1: You haven't followed your orders. Get back here NOW!!
column2: 「你沒有遵守命令。現在立刻回來！！」

column1: You can't just go wherever, whenever you please. Get back here NOW!
column2: 「你不能想去哪裡、什麼時候去就去哪裡。現在立刻回來！」

column1: After acknowledging the transmission, Keith says, "Wow, Sonny. I've never heard Fletch so mad at you before."
column2: 確認通訊後，基斯說：「哇，桑尼。我以前從沒聽過弗萊奇對你這麼生氣。」

column1: We'd better show some results soon, or he'll have our badges!
column2: 「我們最好趕快拿出成果，不然他會收走我們的警徽！」

column1: You'd better get back and report in, Sonny.
column2: 「你最好回來報到，桑尼。」

column1: Keith, as usual, takes in a big puff before responding.
column2: 基斯一如往常，先深吸一大口菸才回答。

column1: Keith takes another deep draft from his cigarette...
column2: 基斯又從香菸深吸一口……

column1: You don't care if I smoke in the car, do you partner?
column2: 「你不介意我在車裡抽菸吧，夥伴？」

column1: Did I ever tell you... my wife thinks I smoke too much, but you don't... DO you?
column2: 「我有沒有告訴過你……我老婆覺得我抽太多，但你不這麼想……對吧？」

column1: You know, Sonny, some crazies are trying to ban smoking, but it doesn't bother you, does it?
column2: 「你知道嗎，桑尼，有些瘋子想禁菸，但你不會介意吧？」

column1: You're always bugging me about my smoking, Sonny, but I know you're not serious, are you?
column2: 「你總是念我抽菸，桑尼，但我知道你不是認真的，對吧？」

column1: Thanks, partner.
column2: 「謝謝，夥伴。」

column1: You're not one of those commie-neo-fascists who want to ban smoking, ARE you, Sonny?!
column2: 「你不是那些想禁菸的共產新法西斯分子之一，對吧，桑尼？！」

column1: I can't BELIEVE you can even SMELL my smoke WAY over THERE!!
column2: 「真不敢相信你在那麼遠的地方居然還聞得到我的菸味！！」

column1: How 'bout if I just open the window? I'll do that for you...
column2: 「不然我把窗戶打開？我就為你這麼做……」

column1: Hey! I don't complain about YOUR habits, DO I?
column2: 「嘿！我可沒有抱怨你的習慣，對吧？」

column1: I can quit... ANYtime. Just... well... not in the middle of a mess like this!
column2: 「我隨時都能戒……隨時。只是……呃……不是在這種混亂的關頭！」

column1: OK, Sonny. You've convinced me. I'll quit smoking, RIGHT after we catch Bains. Yessir. AB-SO-LUTE-LY!
column2: 「好，桑尼。你說服我了。我們抓到班恩斯後，我馬上戒菸。是的，先生。絕——對——會！」

column1: You know, they've never ACTUALLY, SCIENTIFICALLY proven that cigarette smoking causes cancer in people named Keith (Ha Ha).
column2: 「你知道嗎，他們從未真正以科學證明抽菸會讓名叫基斯的人得癌症（笑）。」

column1: How about if I just smoke this one. Then I'll stop for the WHOLE DAY! OK? Thanks, partner. I owe you one.
column2: 「不然就讓我抽完這一根。接下來一整天我都不抽！好嗎？謝謝，夥伴，我欠你一次。」

column1: No foolin'? I never knew my smoking REALLY bothered you! I thought you were just kidding me. You're a real kidder, Sonny, and a GREAT partner, too.
column2: 「不是開玩笑？我真不知道我的抽菸真的讓你困擾！我還以為你只是逗我。你真會開玩笑，桑尼，而且也是個很棒的夥伴。」
